name: Sandwich ELISA Protocol
description: Two-day sandwich ELISA: coat a plate with capture antibody overnight, then block, add samples, detection antibody and avidin-HRP, develop with TMB and read at 450 nm. Reagent dilutions are scheduled inside the incubations. Adapted from the BioLegend Sandwich ELISA Protocol V.3 on protocols.io (CC BY 4.0); incubation times follow the source, hands-on times are estimates. The source also describes ABTS detection read at 405 nm.

tracks.name: Plate
tracks.description: Everything that happens to the 96-well plate

steps.name: Coat plate with capture antibody
steps.description: Dilute the capture antibody to 0.5-8 µg/mL in coating buffer and transfer 100 µL to each well of a high-affinity, protein-binding ELISA plate.

steps.name: Incubate overnight at 4°C
steps.description: Seal the plate to prevent evaporation and incubate at 4°C overnight.

steps.name: Wash 3x
steps.description: Bring the plate to room temperature, flick off the capture antibody solution and wash 3 times with PBS/Tween.

steps.name: Add blocking buffer
steps.description: Block non-specific binding sites by adding 200 µL of blocking solution to each well.

steps.name: Block for 1 hour
steps.description: Seal the plate and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.name: Wash 3x
steps.description: Wash 3 times with PBS/Tween. Firmly blot the plate against clean paper towels.

steps.name: Add standards and samples
steps.description: Add 100 µL per well of the diluted standards and samples.

steps.name: Incubate samples
steps.description: Seal the plate and incubate at room temperature for 2 to 4 hours (or at 4°C overnight).

steps.name: Wash 3x
steps.description: Wash 3 times with PBS/Tween, blotting on clean paper towels between washes.

steps.name: Add detection antibody
steps.description: Add 100 µL of diluted biotin-labeled detection antibody to each well.

steps.name: Incubate detection antibody
steps.description: Seal the plate and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.name: Wash 3x
steps.description: Wash 3 times with PBS/Tween.

steps.name: Add avidin-HRP
steps.description: Add 100 µL per well of diluted avidin-HRP conjugate.

steps.name: Incubate avidin-HRP
steps.description: Seal the plate and incubate at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.name: Wash 5x
steps.description: Wash 5 times with PBS/Tween.

steps.name: Mix TMB substrate
steps.description: Mix 6 mL of TMB Reagent A with 6 mL of TMB Reagent B per plate, immediately before use.

steps.name: Add TMB substrate
steps.description: Transfer 100 µL of freshly mixed TMB substrate into each well.

steps.name: Develop in the dark
steps.description: Incubate at room temperature for colour development, 4 to 30 minutes.

steps.name: Add stop solution
steps.description: Stop the colour reaction by adding 100 µL of TMB stop solution to each well.

steps.name: Read absorbance at 450 nm
steps.description: Read the optical density of each well with a microplate reader set to 450 nm.

tracks.name: Reagent prep
tracks.description: Dilutions prepared while the plate incubates

steps.name: Dilute standards and samples
steps.description: Dilute standards and samples in blocking solution, in polypropylene tubes or a plate, while the plate blocks. Match the standard diluent to the sample matrix.

steps.name: Dilute detection antibody
steps.description: Dilute the biotin-labeled detection antibody to 0.25-2 µg/mL in blocking solution while the samples incubate.

steps.name: Dilute avidin-HRP
steps.description: Dilute the avidin-HRP conjugate in blocking buffer (usually 1/500 to 1/2000) while the detection antibody incubates.

resourceConstraints.description: One plate washer (or one manual wash station)
Room-temperature incubation space for sealed plates
